admission.justification: A requirement that is summarized or split loses obligations silently, and a reader who acts on the shortened text builds the wrong thing; the consolidated text is the only record that reader has.

applicability: The requirement section of a task issue, for each current requirement of that task.
conditions: The task's requirement packets are current and approved.
exclusions: A completed-master summary, which reproduces no requirement.
Historical amendments and requirements the text only mentions, which get no section of their own.

evidence: Each leaf section is consolidated from its cumulative packets; L183 carries ten current requirements and L68 two.

statement: A task issue carries one consolidated text per current requirement, every obligation present in substance, nothing added and no meaning changed; amendments are folded in and superseded wording removed.
